info.title: OpenClockwork API
info.description: Self-hostable working-time tracker — REST + WebSocket surface.

refreshToken.description: A refresh token previously returned from /auth/login or /auth/refresh.

ThemePreference.description: Light / Dark / System. System follows the OS color-scheme media query in the browser.

themePreference.description: Light / Dark / System. System follows the OS color-scheme media query in the browser.

password.description: Initial password — bcrypt-hashed on the server.

startDate.description: ISO date when the employee starts; Soll-Stunden are counted from here.

bundesland.description: ISO-3166-2 code of the German state — drives the holiday calendar.

allowDailyBlockBooking.description: Allow one self-approved fixed-duration block on a configured working day.
Allow one self-approved fixed-duration block on a configured working day.

weekdays.description: Bitmask: Mon=1, Tue=2, Wed=4, Thu=8, Fri=16, Sat=32, Sun=64. Mo–Fr = 31.

workingDays.description: Working-day bitmask. Mon=1, Tue=2, …, Sun=64. Mo–Fr = 31, Mo–Sa = 63.

employeeId.description: Ignored. The employee identity is always taken from the JWT.
Ignored. The employee identity is always taken from the JWT.

dailyNetMinutes.description: Contractual net working minutes for one configured workday.

grossMinutes.description: Attendance minutes including the automatic statutory break.

deviceToken.description: Returned once. Persist securely in the kiosk browser.

payload.description: Opaque value to encode into the displayed QR code.

qrPayload.description: Opaque QR payload emitted by the kiosk.

positionTimestamp.description: Timestamp reported by the fresh browser geolocation reading.

terminalRadiusMeters.description: Terminal geofence radius that was valid when clock-in was accepted.

terminalMaxAccuracyMeters.description: Terminal maximum GPS accuracy that was valid when clock-in was accepted.

clockOutTerminalRadiusMeters.description: Terminal geofence radius that was valid when clock-out was accepted.

clockOutTerminalMaxAccuracyMeters.description: Terminal maximum GPS accuracy that was valid when clock-out was accepted.

logoUrl.description: Same-origin path or a PNG/JPEG/WebP data URL (maximum 60 KiB decoded).
